details.description: Mistral 7B Instruct v0.2 is Mistral AI's second instruction-tuned release of Mistral 7B, published December 11, 2023. Compared with v0.1, its Hugging Face model card describes an expanded 32k-token context window (up from 8k), a Rope-theta value of 1e6, and the removal of sliding-window attention. It is a 7.24-billion-parameter dense transformer released under the Apache 2.0 license. Mistral AI's models overview lists Mistral 7B Instruct as deprecated and replaced by Ministral 3 8B, and lists Mistral 7B (v0.1-v0.3) with a deprecation date of November 30, 2024 and a retirement date of March 30, 2025.
advantages: Expands the context window to 32k tokens, up from 8k in v0.1, per its Hugging Face model card.
Scores 30.84 on the MMLU-Pro benchmark, per its Hugging Face model card.
disadvantages: Mistral states the model has no built-in moderation mechanisms.

Mistral AI's models overview (docs.mistral.ai/getting-started/models/) lists Mistral 7B Instruct as deprecated and replaced by Ministral 3 8B, and lists Mistral 7B (v0.1-v0.3) with a deprecation date of November 30, 2024 and a retirement date of March 30, 2025.
use_cases: General-purpose conversational chat and instruction-following over longer documents, given its 32k-token context window

notes: Catalog facts list max_input_tokens/max_output_tokens of 32768 with no deprecation_date, matching both the Hugging Face card's 32k context window and Fireworks' 32.7k host figure. The MMLU-Pro score of 30.84 was confirmed on two separate fetches of the Hugging Face page. Mistral's own docs state the v0.1-v0.3 line is deprecated (11/30/2024) and retired (3/30/2025), which the catalog's empty deprecation_date does not reflect. Verify pass: the description's publication date was corrected from February 29, 2024 to December 11, 2023 — the Hugging Face repo was created 2023-12-11 and Mistral's mistral.ai/news/la-plateforme post (published 2023-12-11) launched this model as 'mistral-tiny'; no page supports a February 29, 2024 date.
